baseline: v2 blend = 0.5*best021 + 0.5*grain(v2 features, v2 masks) — the dev counterpart of submitted candidate 023 (oof-v2.npz).

arms.A_v2feat_v3mask: same 36 v2 features computed on masks-v3 (isolates the segmentation fix)

masks_v3: v2 masks; images with coverage<0.95 re-segmented with cellprob -3 / flow 1.0 and replaced if coverage increases (label-free rule from lowcov-trial2).
protocol: identical to v2: nested family selection {ridge, krr, hgb} by inner CV on the outer-training folds only; fixed blend w=0.5 with best021; fallback to best021 if n_obj<20; three partitions.
transform: log1p(clip(x,0)) on all columns except signed-by-definition ['logA_skew'] (left raw); fixed by definition.
adoption_rule: Adopt an arm over the v2 blend only if its blend RMSE is lower in all three partitions AND pooled gain vs v2 blend >= 0.10. Report paired pooled CI (descriptive; low power for ~0.1 effects). If both arms qualify, take the one with larger pooled gain.
multiplicity_note: v2 and v3 are the 2nd/3rd looks at the same 400 dev images in this study; dev gains are optimistic.
